genome: MIMAG high-quality draft additionally requires 5S, 16S and 23S rRNA and tRNAs for at least 18 amino acids (Bowers et al. 2017). 32 of 246 MAGs meet all criteria; rRNA genes are commonly lost in metagenome binning. The set is therefore described as near-complete (CheckM2 completeness ≥90%, contamination ≤5%), not MIMAG high-quality. All 246 MAGs are assessed here: 34 carry all three rRNA genes, 221 carry tRNAs for at least 18 amino acids and 32 meet both. spire_mag_01947705 failed Bakta annotation on the first pass and was re-annotated successfully under the same version and database.
